cases.name: Tu-4 (copy of B-29): program start -> first flight
cases.note: B-29: Boeing began work 1938; XB-29 order 24 Aug 1940; first flight 21 Sep 1942. Tu-4: Stalin's copy order after B-29s interned in 1944 (crews left Jan 1945; exact order date not on page -> start 1945-01..1945-07 [推測]); first flight 19 May 1947.

cases.name: R-1 (copy of V-2/A-4): start -> first successful/test flight
cases.note: A-4: larger rocket conceived summer 1936; design/construction ordered c.1938-39; first successful flight 3 Oct 1942. R-1: decree 13 May 1946; production authorized Apr 1947; first tests 13 Sep 1948.

cases.name: R-1 vs V-2: start -> entry into service
cases.note: V-2 first operational launch 8 Sep 1944; R-1 entered service 28 Nov 1950.

cases.name: USSR bomb vs Manhattan: crash program -> first test
cases.note: US: Roosevelt approved 17 Jun 1942 (alt: Briggs committee Oct 1939); Trinity 16 Jul 1945. USSR: accelerated after Aug 1945 (alt: authorized late 1942); RDS-1 29 Aug 1949.
